services.name: Pontoon Boats
services.desc: Dive into a day of unmatched fun and relaxation with a 30-foot, double-decker pontoon boat rental from Center Hill Marina. The upper deck has three slides, perfect for adding a splash of excitement to your day. Maximum capacity for our pontoon boats is 14 people. We do not provide life jackets for infants. Escape the daily grind and immerse yourself in the tranquility of Center Hill Lake with a pontoon boat rental from Center Hill Marina. Our spacious pontoons, measuring 10′ x 30′, are the perfect platform for a relaxing day of swimming, fishing, or simply soaking in the scenic beauty. This pontoon boat does not have slides. We do not provide life jackets for infants. Rental Time Period
